title: Nourishing Kenyan Mincemeat Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring mincemeat and a blend of Kenyan spices, served in a hot pot vessel. This dish is perfect for a cozy evening with friends and family.
instructions: Heat oil in a hot pot vessel over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the mincemeat and cook until it is browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the beef broth, potatoes, and carrots, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew for 30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
